title: ToolMate UI
description: Clean, accessible, and customizable building blocks crafted with modern Tailwind CSS. Fully compatible with React, Astro, Vue, Svelte, and plain HTML.
longDescription: ToolMate UI is a collection of 15+ production-ready, accessible UI primitives and templates crafted with modern Tailwind CSS. Built with zero runtime dependencies and copy-and-paste ease, it provides plug-and-play components across React, Next.js, Astro, Vue, Svelte, and HTML.
